# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2015

**Supplemental Budget #02 — P10,294,196.86 for Personnel Benefits, Various Priority Programs and Projects**

Resolution No. 107

## Summary

Enacts Supplemental Budget No. 02 for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], totaling **P10,294,196.86**. Covers personnel benefits and various priority programs and projects. Introduced by Coun. [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Total Supplemental Appropriation:** P10,294,196.86
- **Personnel Benefits:** Funds allocated for personnel-related expenses
- **Priority Programs and Projects:** Covers various priority programs and projects of the municipality
